# Direct dependencies of the integration test module (tests/integration).
#
# This module is never imported by users; it exists so database drivers stay
# out of wardn's own go.mod. Entries still need a justification and review.
#
# Format: <module path>  # <why it is needed>

github.com/MogRex-Limited/wardn      # The module under test (replaced with ../..).
github.com/MogRex-Limited/wardn/store/pgx # The pgx store, tested against the SQL store on the same database (replaced with ../../store/pgx).
github.com/jackc/pgx/v5              # PostgreSQL driver: the most widely used Go Postgres driver.
github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql       # MySQL and MariaDB driver: the standard Go MySQL driver.
modernc.org/sqlite                   # SQLite driver in pure Go: no cgo, runs everywhere.
github.com/go-chi/chi/v5             # Router used to test wardn's HTTP middleware the way product teams use it.
